b03_caution: The 0.80s aggregate b03 difference is dominated by guard/cache/startup variability (full guard 1.79s, cone 0.99s), not its ~1ms compiled validation; retain both trials but do not interpret b03 percentage as algorithm speedup.
b20_observation: Across both repetitions, compiled validation rises from 16.46s to 23.26s, including 14.22s of cold cone planning; primary pipeline rises by 6.50s (9.01%).
finding: Every consumed model built a fresh assumption plan in this stream. The nominal compiled gate-count reduction does not price DFS set/stack traversal, node sorting and tuple plan allocation, complete projection validation, or immutable capture.
limitations: Two repetitions quantify this run, not statistical confidence. Full pipeline includes the declared test-only reference check. No model choices, proofs, products, or area metrics change.
measured_scope: Two fixed order-reversed sweeps of the identical consumed model stream, including guards, upstream binding layers, cold plans, both original AIG passes, admission, output and full-sample reference validation.
mem_ctrl_observation: Across both repetitions, compiled validation drops from 18.50s to 9.21s; primary pipeline drops by 9.44s (11.82%).
recommendation: Keep exact-cone experimental. The 2.76% observed fixed-stream pipeline reduction and mixed per-case effects do not establish an end-to-end transform improvement or justify another formal cohort by themselves. Any later code hypothesis should first address cold one-use plan overhead under the same fixed model stream; no retuning or runtime change was performed here.
